title: Loch Maree Hotel
axis: Positive Z faces the A832 road to the southwest. Positive X runs southeast along the long roof.

mappedIdentity.name: Loch Maree Hotel
mappedIdentity.address: Loch Maree Hotel, Talladale, Achnasheen, Wester Ross, Scotland

features.role: Current named building footprint used to register the original hotel phase on the same site.

identityStatus: The existing hotel is identified by its mapped name and distinct building entity. The nineteenth-century photograph-derived engraving constrains the original frontage and side proportions. Present outline is the positional tie.

terrainContact.basis: Unmodified Copernicus GLO-30 at the approximated southwest historic entrance. The foundation spans the loch-side grade.

notes: The October 1877 issue of The Graphic shows the paired sash windows, recessed main entry, dormer, prominent gables, chimney stacks and southeast bay.
